CS 301 - Data Structures and Algorithms
Fall Term 2026
Instructor: Dr. R. Mehta
Lecture: MWF 9:00 - 10:00, Room Eng 214
Office hours: Tuesday 14:00

Grading:
Problem Sets 20%
Programming Project 30%
Midterm Exam 20%
Final Exam 25%
Participation 5%

Course Schedule

Week 1: Course introduction, complexity analysis and asymptotic notation
  Reading: CLRS Chapter 1, pp. 1-28

Week 2: Arrays, strings and the two-pointer technique
  Reading: CLRS Chapter 2

Week 3: Linked lists, stacks and queues
  Reading: CLRS Chapter 10, pp. 235-260
  Problem Set 1 due Sep 25 at 11:59 PM

Week 4: Recursion and backtracking
  Reading: CLRS Chapter 4

Week 5: Trees, traversals and binary search trees
  Reading: CLRS Chapter 12
  Quiz 1 in class

Week 6: Balanced trees and heaps
  Reading: CLRS Chapter 13

Week 7: Hash tables and amortised analysis
  Reading: CLRS Chapter 11
  Problem Set 2 due Oct 16 at 11:59 PM

Week 8: Midterm review and exam
  Midterm Exam on Oct 21

Week 9: Graphs, breadth-first and depth-first search
  Reading: CLRS Chapter 22

Week 10: Shortest paths and Dijkstra's algorithm
  Reading: CLRS Chapter 24

Week 11: Dynamic programming
  Reading: CLRS Chapter 15
  Project proposal due Nov 6

Week 12: Greedy algorithms
  Reading: CLRS Chapter 16

Week 13: Project work week

Week 14: Final project demonstration and submission
  Final Project due Dec 4
